screens.title: What you can handle now
screens.body: Look at what you can do today that was harder before:
bullets: When Margaret asks the same thing again, you can answer the feeling first.
When there's a lot to take in, you can say one thing, slowly.
When Margaret says something was taken, you can join the search instead of arguing.
When Margaret says no, you can offer a small choice.
screens.patternTip: A hard day doesn't undo this. Come back to your phrase book any time.

screens.title: One pause that works for you.
screens.body: Whatever Margaret says, a small pause before you answer helps you stay kind. Choose the one you'll really use.

miniTask.question: Pick your pause for next time:

options.label: One slow breath before I answer
Tell myself: this is a feeling, not a fight
Step away for a minute, if it's safe

ifThen.cue: If Margaret is upset or says no,

doNow.title: One thing to do now
doNow.text: Choose the one phrase from your phrase book you'll use first. Put it where you'll see it, like a note on your phone or the fridge.
